name: ts_inventory_restock
prompt:
Fix the TypeScript inventory restock bug.

Requirements:
- Modify restock.ts only.
- calculateRestockAmount must reject negative currentStock.
- calculateRestockAmount must reject negative reorderPoint.
- calculateRestockAmount must reject non-positive maxCapacity.
- calculateRestockAmount must reject reorderPoint > maxCapacity.
- When currentStock < reorderPoint, return (maxCapacity - currentStock).
- When currentStock >= reorderPoint, return 0.
- Rejected inputs must throw an Error.
- Do not modify main.ts or products.ts.
- Do not create new files.
- Use patch_candidate if only calculateRestockAmount changes.
- target_snippet must be copied verbatim from the actual file.

Validation command: node --experimental-strip-types main.ts
